shell.wireless_dialog.guide: Follow the wireless debugging screen on the device. Pair first, then return to the wireless debugging main page, read the connection port, and connect manually.
shell.wireless_dialog.port_notice: The pairing port and connection port are different. Read the pairing port from the "Pair device with pairing code" dialog; read the connection port from "IP address and port" on the wireless debugging main page.
shell.wireless_dialog.step_1_body: On the Android device, open Developer options and enable Wireless debugging. The computer and device must be on the same network.
shell.wireless_dialog.step_2_body: Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the device, enter the IP address, pairing port, and pairing code shown there, then pair.
shell.wireless_dialog.step_3_body: After pairing succeeds, return to the wireless debugging main page, read the port in "IP address and port", enter it as the connection port, then connect the device.
